guarding.title: Security Guarding
guarding.desc: Fixed posts or mobile patrols, set according to the nature of each site. Uniformed, supervised teams secure entrances, perimeters and daily operations.
guarding.b1: Fixed guard posts and mobile patrols
guarding.rec: Malls, residential compounds, factories and government facilities that need a consistent, visible presence.

surveillance.title: Electronic Surveillance & Control Rooms
surveillance.desc: Surveillance cameras linked to a central control room for continuous monitoring and documentation of activity across your site.
surveillance.b1: CCTV linked to a central control room
surveillance.rec: Large or multi-entrance sites where visibility and a documented record matter.

events.title: Event & Occasion Security
events.desc: Flexible, temporary security coverage for exhibitions, conferences and large events, with teams able to move quickly and manage crowds.
events.rec: Exhibitions, conferences, seasonal events and large bookings.

personal.title: Personal Protection
personal.desc: Qualified protection teams that escort and secure VIPs according to precise security protocols.
personal.rec: Executives, guests of honor and high-profile visits that require discreet, disciplined protection.

risk.title: Risk Assessment & Management
risk.desc: We assess security risks at your facility and deliver preventive plans built on the findings.
risk.rec: Facilities launching or reviewing their security setup and wanting a clear, evidence-based plan.

training.rec: Organizations that want their own security staff trained to professional standards.

about.description: Edarah Security Services is a specialist provider of integrated security for the public and private sectors, serving commercial, industrial, residential and government clients. We offer guarding, electronic surveillance, risk management and training programs that qualify our security staff to the highest professional standards.
about.group: Edarah is part of Obaikan Holding Group, one of Saudi Arabia's leading economic groups, with a long presence in real estate development, contracting, operations, investment and property management.

about.mission: To deliver integrated security solutions designed around each client's needs, relying on qualified personnel, clear operating methods and modern monitoring systems, so clients can focus on their business without worry.
